name: trace-file-lineage
description: Local-first provenance and artifact navigation for files produced by code, documents, commands, and agent tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Trace artifact origins, impact, and task runs.
interface.longDescription: Investigate where local files came from, rank historical producer candidates with explicit uncertainty, record future task changes, and export focused lineage views.
defaultPrompt: Find the code and data that produced this artifact.
Show what depends on this input file.
Explain the files created by this recorded run.
